sources.title: Fine-tuning Multi-modal LLMs with ART: - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Our fine-tuning adapts the model by optimizing a single task-specific ART input image routed through the standard vision pathway. The model remains completely frozen, and fine-tuned prompts are treated by the serving infrastructure as plain multi-modal requests.

sources.title: ms-paint-drawing-flux | PromptLayer Models
sources.snippet: ms-paint-drawing-flux is a specialized LoRA model designed to generate images that mimic the distinctive aesthetic of Microsoft Paint drawings. Originally migrated from CivitAI, this model intentionally creates "low-quality" artwork that captures the nostalgic charm and quirky characteristics of MS Paint-style digital art.
